use default
use IO.Std.read_line

let lines = [
    (0, 1, 2), (3, 4, 5), (6, 7, 8),
    (0, 3, 6), (1, 4, 7), (2, 5, 8),
    (0, 4, 8), (2, 4, 6)
]

winner(board: List[char]) -> char? =>
    lines
        |> filter(((a, b, c)) =>
            board[a] != ' ' /\ board[a] == board[b] /\ board[b] == board[c])
        |> map(((a, _, _)) => board[a])
        |> first()

free(board: List[char]) -> Pipe[int] =>
    (0..9) |> filter(i => board[i] == ' ')

full(board: List[char]) -> bool => !(board |> any(c => c == ' '))

other(player: char) -> char => if player == 'X' then 'O' else 'X' fi

score(board: LIST[char], player: char) -> int is
    if winner(board)? then
        return -1
    fi

    let best mut = if full(board) then 0 else -1 fi

    for cell in free(board) |> collect_list() do
        board[cell] = player
        let result = -score(board, other(player))
        board[cell] = ' '

        if result > best then
            best = result
        fi
    od

    best
si

best_move(board: LIST[char]) -> int is
    let move mut = -1
    let best mut = -2

    for cell in free(board) |> collect_list() do
        board[cell] = 'O'
        let result = -score(board, 'X')
        board[cell] = ' '

        if result > best then
            best = result
            move = cell
        fi
    od

    move
si

label(board: List[char], index: int) -> string =>
    if board[index] == ' ' then "{index + 1}" else "{board[index]}" fi

show(board: List[char]) is
    for row in 0..3 do
        write_line(
            (0..3)
                |> map(column => label(board, row * 3 + column))
                |> join(" | "))
    od
si

let board = LIST[char]((0..9) |> map(_ => ' '))
let player mut = 'X'

show(board)

while !winner(board)? /\ !full(board) do
    if player == 'X' then
        write_line("your move (1-9)?")

        let line = read_line()

        if !line? then
            break
        fi

        write_line("> {line}")

        let cell mut = 0

        let legal =
            int.try_parse(line, cell ref) /\
            cell >= 1 /\ cell <= 9 /\ board[cell - 1] == ' '

        if !legal then
            write_line("choose a free square from 1 to 9")
            continue
        fi

        board[cell - 1] = 'X'
    else
        let cell = best_move(board)
        write_line("I take {cell + 1}")
        board[cell] = 'O'
    fi

    show(board)
    player = other(player)
od

if let who = winner(board) then
    write_line(if who == 'X' then "you win" else "I win" fi)
elif full(board) then
    write_line("a draw")
fi
